name: agentic-dev-workflow
description: Adaptive agentic software development and SDD workflow plugin for Antigravity 2.0. Supports both strict Spec-Driven Development (openspec/ create, validate, status, archive, bug-triage) and lightweight/legacy non-SDD projects with explicit opt-out. Includes interactive discovery and tech research workflows, modular .agents/ artifact creators (skills, rules, subagents, hooks, MCP servers), and sdd-prompt-craft with sdd-prompt-architect.
